11. X doesn't touch a drop of alcohol, but he is a legendary chain-smoker. Roadies have often joked that X has two speeds: 0 and 100. Backstage, he sits quietly in a corner, barely speaking, chain-smoking cigarettes and drinking tea.
The moment he hits the stage, he becomes a superhuman athlete for two hours, losing several pounds in sweat every single night. Doctors have marveled at how he maintains that level of cardio while being a heavy smoker for over 50 years. He once said that if he has his guitar and a pack of cigarettes, he doesn't really need anything else from the outside world. Id X.
